using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

class Program
{
    private static int total;
    private static int number;
    static void Main(string[] args)
    {
        total = 0;
        for (number = 1; number <= 99; number++)
        {
            if ((((number % 3) == 0) || ((number % 5) == 0)))
            {
                total = (total + number);
            }
        }
        Console.WriteLine(total);
    }
